record.title: Abkhaz H1N1 closure at Enguri
record.scope: Ordinary departures from Abkhazia through Enguri under the H1N1 restriction
record.direction: Principally Abkhazia-to-Tbilisi-controlled territory; return entry into Abkhazia allowed under initial rules
record.movement: Ordinary local departures excluding medical cases, Enguri HPP staff and visa-holders permitted under exceptions
record.exceptions: Return into Abkhazia under initial rules; medical cases, Enguri HPP staff and visa-holders; ordinary document requirements persisted
record.enforcement: Resident interviews and the Georgian ministry confirm reopening on 5 February.
record.official_rationale: Prevent H1N1 spread from Georgian-controlled territory.
record.uncertainty: Abkhaz onset is bounded January 10–11 across substantive accounts. January 11 at 20:00 in Civil Georgia concerns South Ossetia and must not be transferred to Enguri. February 5 restoration and directional exceptions remain supported.

historical.duration_note: Calendar-date difference to the stated actual reopening for the specified category and crossing; not exact hours or universal closure. A bounded one-direction policy interval, not complete border impermeability. Subsequent document requirements are a separate regime.
